facts.subject: Bottle House of Ganja (Gəncə, corner of Hüseyn Cavid and Qəmbər Hüseynli streets): built 1966–67 by Ganja resident İbrahim Cəfərov (Wikipedia: 'built by Ibrahim Jafarov … in 1966-67', infobox 1966 → 1967; azerbaijan.travel: 'completed in 1967 by Ibrahim Jafarov'). '48000 bottles were used' (Wikipedia) / '48,000 bottles of different sizes and colours' (azerbaijan.travel), plus 'colorful stones brought from Sochi' (Wikipedia). Two storeys (both). Dedicated to the memory of his brother who went missing in World War II (both); 'a big portrait of missing brother Yusif Jafarov' under the roof at the front (Wikipedia). The word 'Ganja' is written on several parts with bottle bottoms, while the city was officially 'Kirovabad (1935-1989)' (Wikipedia); walls also mention the 1980 Moscow Olympics (Wikipedia; our photo b shows 'ОЛИМПИАДА' in bottles). Private property / private residence, no fee (Wikipedia, Atlas Obscura). NOT used: exact number of stones, current owner name, '1967' inscription wording.

facts.subject: Beluga sturgeon (Huso huso; AZ: bölgə), a fish of the Caspian and Black Sea basins ('Most beluga sturgeon were historically found in the Caspian Sea' — Animal Diversity Web). Largest accepted record: a female caught in 1827 in the Volga estuary (Caspian), 1 571 kg and 7.2 m (Wikipedia; larger 2 000–3 000 kg claims 'disputed and unconfirmed'; ADW's 3 200 kg NOT used). 'It is the largest freshwater fish in the world' (Wikipedia; ADW hedged 'may be the largest'). Females mature at 16–22 years (Wikipedia; ADW 'normally after 15 years') and spawn every 4–7 years (Wikipedia; ADW 4–8). Lifespan: 'capable of surviving over 100 years' but no specimens recently 'past their 56th year' (Wikipedia + ADW both). Status: Critically Endangered, IUCN (Wikipedia; 2022 assessment). US banned imports of beluga caviar from the Caspian since 6 Oct 2005 (Wikipedia citing USFWS). Females can produce ~12% of body weight as caviar (ADW only → NOT in voice).

Finalda beş hakimin hamısı onu seçdi. Ən maraqlısı: ilk Avropa qızılını iki il əvvəl elə bu şəhərdə qazanmışdı. Bəyən və izlə — hər gün bilmədiyin bir fakt!
reel_1830.language_check: Section L: short sentences (≤ 12 words), everyday words; 'X-a qalib gəlmək' not used (no object); 'hakimin hamısı onu seçdi' plain spoken; numbers written out; no Turkish/Russian forms.
